position: Read-only hosted adapter selected; deployment not authorized
headline: The next backend slice is one portable source contract, not a premature platform.
copy: A pure handler can serve health, source, sources, and search responses from the reviewed registry without accounts, writes, secrets, model calls, or framework lock-in.

postures.title: Data source
postures.copy: Versioned reviewed registry bundled at build time.

postures.title: Write paths
postures.copy: No learner, review, telemetry, or registry mutation endpoint.

postures.title: Live model
postures.copy: No generation or model credential belongs in this slice.

postures.title: Deployment
postures.copy: Provider, region, budget, and operations remain a founder decision.

flow.title: Adapt
flow.copy: Map a platform request into the pure handler contract.

flow.title: Resolve
flow.copy: Use the same reviewed registry and no-source behavior as the local API.

flow.title: Return
flow.copy: Emit the versioned source envelope with no-store and request trace metadata.

flow.title: Observe
flow.copy: Add production logging and abuse controls only after explicit privacy design.

decisions.label: Architecture
decisions.reason: It preserves the proven contract with the smallest blast radius.

decisions.label: Provider
decisions.reason: No cloud vendor is required to validate the service boundary.

decisions.label: Database
decisions.reason: The first hosted slice reads a reviewed build artifact.

decisions.label: Next build
decisions.reason: A provider-specific preview can follow only with credentials and deployment approval.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No model call or generated scripture is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable learner, reviewer, observation, or telemetry storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No translation text is published without recorded rights evidence.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The product remains study and reflection support, not a guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private-demo evidence does not authorize a public service.

Data: reviewed build-time registry.
Excluded: database, accounts, writes, telemetry, payments, model calls, and public launch.
